welcome.title: Welcome to Humcase
welcome.intro: A case is an idea, a task, a question or a decision. You write, your agents file their work in it, you decide.
welcome.writeText: Type or dictate what’s on your mind. The title writes itself.
welcome.agentText: Claude, Codex, Cursor or opencode: it files its work in your cases and leaves the decisions to you.
welcome.captureText: An idea during a call or in another app: this shortcut opens a small capture window.
welcome.howHeading: With an agent, it goes like this
welcome.howAgentText: It adds its sub-cases and its report, under its own name.
welcome.howDecideText: Accept, or ask for a rework with your reason. Everything stays in the history.
welcome.exampleShow: See it with a filled example
